question: 'Sattriya Nritya' is the classical dance of which of the following Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sattriya Nritya** is one of the **eight classical dance forms of India**, recognized by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• It originates from the northeastern state of **Assam** and was introduced by the great Vaishnavite saint and reformer, **Srimanta Sankardeva**, in the 15th century.
 
• This dance form was initially performed by male monks known as **‘Bhakats’** in **Satras** (Vaishnavite monasteries) as a form of storytelling and devotion.
 
• Sattriya Nritya combines elements of **music, drama, and dance**, and its performances are deeply rooted in the **Vaishnavite tradition**.
